requirement_structuring.structuring_summary: Requirement R-F-18 mixes a functional action (inform security service) with a trigger condition (detector detects damage). Per Pohl §25.2, decomposed into one functional requirement and one quality/constraint requirement regarding the nature of the notification.

source_fragments: If the detector detects damage to the pane, the system shall inform the security service.

fields.condition: the detector detects damage to the pane

structured_requirements.final_statement: If the detector detects damage to the pane, the system shall inform the security service.
structuring_notes: Extracted functional action from concern-mixed requirement. Trigger condition preserved as event.

fields.condition: upon detection of damage to the pane

structured_requirements.final_statement: The system shall inform the security service upon detection of damage to the pane.
structuring_notes: Reframed as a quality requirement regarding the system's capability to notify, though specific metrics (e.g., latency) are not defined in the source text.
